_comment: Runtime model assignments by GPU role. The brain uses this to select which model to load. The catalog (models.catalog.json) is the full inventory of available models; this file defines what should actually run. First entry in each list is the default. Future: brain picks alternatives based on task-model fit from benchmarking data.

single_gpu._comment: Models for individual GPU workers (gpu-1 through gpu-5). Default is loaded on startup and when tasks don't specify a model.

alternatives.notes: Stronger reasoning, slower. Good for score_person, evaluate tasks.
Lighter model, faster inference. Good for simple extraction tasks.
Larger but fits single GPU with Q3_K_M quant. Better quality than 7b for complex tasks.

split_gpu._comment: Models requiring two GPUs in a split pair (pair_1_3 or pair_4_5).

brain._comment: Model for the brain agent (gpu-0, 3090). Handles monitoring, evaluation, goal planning.
